prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me build a short, tailored shortlist and comparison:

Questions
- What are your primary goals? (SEO, paid ads/PPC, social media, content marketing, web design, full-service, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget or preferred pricing model (project vs retainer)?
- Are you B2B or B2C? What industry or niche?
- Company size and expected timeline for results?
- Do you prefer a local St. Louis agency (in-person) or is a remote/national shop OK?

How I’ll evaluate agencies (so you get the “best” for you)
- Relevant experience and case studies in your industry
- Measurable results and KPIs (lead cost, conversion lift, ROI)
- Client retention, references, and reviews
- Certifications (Google Partner, Meta, HubSpot, etc.)
- Reporting transparency, communication style, and team structure
- Pricing and contract flexibility
- Cultural fit and strategic approach (long-term vs tactical)

Quick selection checklist you can use when interviewing agencies
- Can you show specific case studies with metrics similar to our goals?
- Who will be on our account team — will work be done in-house?
- What KPIs will you report and how often?
- What tools and platforms do you use? Who owns the assets?
- What is your onboarding process and expected 3/6/12-month milestones?
- Can you provide client references I can contact?
- What are typical contract terms and minimum retainer?
- How do you measure ROI for campaigns?
- What are common failure modes and how do you avoid them?
- Are there additional costs (ad spend, creative, tech)?

If you want, I can:
- Research and produce a ranked shortlist of top-rated St. Louis agencies based on your answers
- Create a one-page RFP and evaluation scorecard you can send to agencies
- Draft email templates to request proposals and references

Which option would you like to do next?
